subject: Acceptance signal contract + MAP milestones — CareScale pilot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@carescale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-18T16:12:00Z
Subject: Acceptance signal contract + MAP milestones — CareScale pilot

Hi Sanjay —

Great to meet earlier. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an acceptance-test catalog that defines the measurable success signals we propose for the CareScale pilot. High level:

- Scope: Assist triage workflows for claims processing (sample workload attached).
- Core acceptance buckets: functional correctness (concordance vs. human baseline), latency/throughput, reliability & failover, security/compliance checkpoints.
- Exit gates (proposed):
  - Smoke: end-to-end sanity run with sample dataset (one business day)
  - Fidelity: >= 92% concordance on 500 sampled records across critical intents for 3 consecutive days
  - Performance: 95th percentile latency < 450ms on steady-state traffic profile (5k qpm simulated)
  - Reliability: no system-level P1 incidents during canary window; any P1 triggers rollback clause

Please review the attached "care-scale-map-v1.xlsx" (MAP timeline + owners) and "acceptance-tests-v1.md" (test definitions). Proposed timeline: agree on MAP by Oct 25, technical canary week Nov 2–9, production-cutover target Nov 16 subject to acceptance.

Next asks: can you confirm (a) your analytics owner for signing off concordance samples, and (b) procurement timeline for SOW? If you want changes to any gate thresholds, flag them and we can surface to leadership.

Thanks —
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: care-scale-map-v1.xlsx (xlsx), acceptance-tests-v1.md (md)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@carescale.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Gupta <rajiv@carescale.com>
Date: 2025-10-19T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Acceptance signal contract + MAP milestones — CareScale pilot

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary and drafts. Rajiv and I reviewed the MAP and acceptance tests. A few notes:

- Concordance threshold: we prefer a slightly higher fidelity threshold for clinical-tier intents — can we adopt 95% for those (rest remain at 92%)?
- Canary timing: Nov 2–9 looks fine but procurement is slower on our side; can we move the technical canary to Nov 9–16 and finish SOW by Nov 3? Procurement has a purchase-order turnaround of ~10 business days.
- Compliance checkpoint: we need one mandatory audit-run (SOC2 artifacts + data residency checklist) before canary. I'll attach our procurement form.

If you can update the MAP with the two-tier concordance gates and add a compliance signoff row (owner: Rajiv), we'll be closer to green.

Best,
Sanjay
Director of Product, CareScale
Attachment: procurement-form.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@carescale.com>, Rajiv Gupta <rajiv@carescale.com>
Date: 2025-10-19T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Acceptance signal contract + MAP milestones — CareScale pilot

Looping in Marissa for visibility. Sanjay — thanks for the quick review. I've sketched an updated acceptance ledger (see notes below) and will push an updated MAP v1.1 to Drive when agreed:

- Acceptance tiers: we will implement a 'clinical-tier' label in the sample set; those records will be subject to the 95% concordance gate. Owner: Ben Carter (SE).
- Measurement cadence: daily sampling during canary, with automated aggregation to a shared dashboard (owner: Analytics team). We'll require 3 consecutive days passing to trigger go/no-go.
- Compliance/Artifacts: Marissa to confirm whether SOC2 evidence can be shared ahead of canary; if not, add a hard blocker in the MAP.
- Canary window: prefer Nov 9–16 (aligns with CareScale procurement ask). We'll reserve a conservative production-cutover window Nov 18–22 with a 48-hour rollback & monitoring period post-cutover.

Risk and rollback: any P1 incident or regression >5 percentage points vs baseline triggers immediate rollback and postmortem. We'll also run a small-scale canary (10% traffic) for first 48 hours before ramp.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/34567/CS-2025-Q4-091), MAP draft on Drive (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD23eF). I'll upload the updated MAP and acceptance tests by EOD tomorrow.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@carescale.com>, Rajiv Gupta <rajiv@carescale.com>
Date: 2025-10-20T21:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Acceptance signal contract + MAP milestones — CareScale pilot

Forwarding final guidance — all, looks good. Marissa from Sales Ops here. A few governance notes before we lock: 

- Approve the two-tier concordance thresholds (95% clinical, 92% generic).
- SOC2 artifacts: legal asked that we deliver non-sensitive SOC2 evidence to CareScale by Nov 3; Ben, please confirm whether the artifacts Ben referenced can be shared by that date or if we need a limited NDA route.
- SOW & billing: finance approves the draft SOW with a small SLA exception for pilot (write into the SOW: "pilot SLA measured during canary; production SLA effective after cutover and signoff"). I'll attach the SOW draft — please review and return comments within 48 hours.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Ben: upload MAP v1.1 with compliance row and updated owners (due 2025-10-20 EOD)
- Tessa: confirm meeting with CareScale procurement for Nov 3 (invite sent)
- Sanjay & Rajiv: confirm analytics owner and procurement timeline (confirm by 2025-10-23)
- Marissa: finalize SOW draft and share DocuSign link when updated

We will treat the acceptance checklist as the contractual gate for cutover. If all owners sign by Nov 3 and SOC2 artifacts are validated, we hold to the Nov 9 canary start. Otherwise we rebaseline.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sow-draft-20251018.pdf (pdf)
